Privacy Policy

Pharma Near You · last updated 10 September 2026

The short version. There is no account, no server of ours, and no analytics. Your notes, your medicines and your profile never leave your phone. Your location is used on the device to sort pharmacies by distance and is not sent to us — because there is nowhere to send it.

What the app stores on your device

  • Your medication list, reminders and personal notes, including any photos you attach to them.
  • The name and details you optionally enter on the profile screen.
  • Your favourite pharmacies.
  • Settings such as language, theme and search radius.
  • A downloaded copy of the pharmacy data for your country, so the app works offline.

All of it stays in the app's private storage. Uninstalling the app deletes it. We cannot see any of it, and there is no way for us to recover it.

Location

If you grant location permission, the app reads your position to show which pharmacies are nearest and to sort them by distance. The calculation happens entirely on your phone. Your position is not transmitted anywhere, is not stored between sessions, and is not attached to any identifier.

You can refuse the permission. The app still works: it opens on a default view and you can search by town instead.

Where the pharmacy data comes from

Pharmacy locations and opening hours come from OpenStreetMap, contributed by its volunteers and used under the Open Database License. The app downloads a pre-built file for your country from static hosting. That download is an ordinary web request: the host sees that a file was requested, as any website would, and nothing about you is included in it.

Map tiles are served by OpenFreeMap, which likewise receives only the requests needed to draw the map.

Advertising

The free version of the app shows advertising through Google AdMob. AdMob may use a device advertising identifier to select and measure ads. In the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom you are asked for consent before any personalised ad is requested, through Google's own consent form, and you can change that answer at any time.

The Pro subscription removes all advertising, and with it the ad requests.

Google's handling of this data is described in Google's privacy policy.

Subscriptions

Pro is billed by Google Play or by Apple, depending on where you installed the app. Payment details are handled entirely by the store and are never seen by this app. We receive only whether a subscription is active.

Children

The app is not directed at children and collects nothing that would identify one.

Your rights

Because nothing is collected on a server, there is no account to close and no data of yours for us to export or delete. Removing everything the app holds is done by uninstalling it, or by deleting individual notes and medicines inside the app.

Changes

If this policy changes, the updated version appears at this address with a new date at the top.
